Why Carefree is its own job

A lot of Carefree houses are empty for months, and an empty house is not a clean house.

Carefree has a high proportion of seasonal residents, and a closed-up desert home does something specific over a summer: dust settles undisturbed onto every horizontal surface, the water in traps evaporates, and soft furnishings hold whatever was in the air in May. Coming back to it in October is not a tidying job. It is the deep-clean list — vents, fans, light fixtures, woodwork, upholstery vacuumed, baseboards by hand — which is exactly what we publish.

If you are arriving on a date, tell us the date. An open-up clean booked for the day before is the difference between walking in and unpacking.
